text: The Medical Officer of Health, the Director, Public Health, Strategy and Clinical Services and the Associate Director, Strategic Initiatives, Toronto Public Health will give a presentation on Toronto Public Health’s Strategic Plan 2024-2028.

The Board of Health - Strategic Plan Development Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Health direct the Medical Officer of Health to develop an implementation plan that includes monitoring and tracking to measure progress for the 2024-2028 Strategic Plan and to report to the Board of Health with annual progress reports on the implementation of the 2024-2028 Strategic Plan. 2. The Board of Health direct the Medical Officer of Health to develop a public dashboard that will track the progress of implementation of the 2024-2028 Strategic Plan. 3. The Board of Health direct the Medical Officer of Health to include a “Strategic Impact” section on all reports from Toronto Public Health to the Board of Health which outlines how the report aligns with and advances strategic priorities and objectives. 4.
